interpretation: These are intentionally exaggerated synthetic assumptions, not descriptions of actual people.
Within each pair only the listed fields and tracking ID/display name differ; across pairs multiple conditions differ.
Names are also model input; experience may induce inferred knowledge. This is not proof of a pure human single-trait causal effect.
No target label, candidate ID, URL route, click order or forced success/abandonment is supplied in Persona files.
Device assumptions are not an actual browser/device emulation or enforced OS policy.
Definitions do not establish execution or validation. See the separate extreme-persona-study protocol and results; existing native output/token/timeout limitations are unchanged.
The public cohort runner accepts this file via explicit --persona-set; the legacy default remains baseline/A/B/C. --max-decisions changes harness censoring only.
